A completely unmemorable plot makes this largely a waste of time, especially since it is so hard to get invested in any of the characters. However, this book is still worth reading as the "sixth magic" (<a class="review-spoiler-link" href="https://www.goodreads.com/review/show/2565165839">(view spoiler)</a>) goes far beyond creative. Nothing comes up interesting regarding it, but it's still super cool to think about.
